nodes.label: Never Sed-Patch Server Rule
nodes.rationale: Sed patches get overwritten on the next deploy; workflow must be fix locally -> commit -> push -> deploy (under 3 minutes total). A sed patch saves 2 minutes but creates a time bomb.

nodes.label: dd_score NameError Incident
nodes.rationale: Apr 12 sed patch on server was overwritten by Apr 20 deploy; engine ran broken 2+ days, missing a validated $2-3K confluence_breakout trade.
